children: SAP SE Sponsored ADR (XETR:SAP) boosted buybacks to 8,305,886 shares after recent XETRA repurchases while striking a five‑year AWS deal to expand its SAP Business AI Platform and simultaneously rolling out AI skills programs in the UAE for students and employees.
SAP SE Sponsored ADR Buybacks Rise
: SAP SE Sponsored ADR (SAP) repurchased 1,823,857 shares via XETRA Sept 7–11 and 50,000 shares Sept 14–18, raising total buybacks to 8,305,886 shares as of Sept 18, 2026.
SAP SE ADR, AWS Five-Year AI Expansion
: SAP SE ADR (SAP) struck a five-year deal with Amazon Web Services to expand SAP Business AI Platform into seven more AWS regions, hosting AI services closer to customer locations.
: SAP (SAP) said it will expand AI skills in the UAE via the Young Professionals Programme, University Alliances and micro-credential training for students, early-career hires and current employees.
